lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: # comprehende-47: Replace tickets with first-class sources

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: PR #47, closes ticket #46. Three review comments from Máté, all addressed in the PR.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Story

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Title: the PR title.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Why: present, from #46. The reader cannot see where the why comes from.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Size: large.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Parts: one story. Groups: 5 to 7.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Groups

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 1. Source schema and parser: `src/schema/types.ts`, `src/schema/parse.ts`, `src/schema/parse.test.ts`, `src/schema/source.ts`, `src/schema/source.test.ts`, `src/schema/review.schema.json`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 2. validate and serve check citations and pins: `src/review/pins.ts`, `src/review/pins.test.ts`, `src/cli/*`, `src/api/live.ts`, `src/api/types.ts`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 3. The prompt from "Ask an AI about this" lists sources: `src/api/agent-md.ts` and its test. This can merge with group 2.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 4. Citations and the Sources row: `InlineMd.tsx`, `SourceCite.tsx`, `SourceList.tsx`, `Overview.tsx`, `GroupBrief.tsx`, `sources-context.tsx`, `inline-md.ts`, `source-display.ts`, `tooltip.tsx`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 5. Comment pins on the diff: `CommentPin.tsx`, `PierreDiff.tsx`, `HunkView.tsx`, `Group.tsx`, `App.tsx`, `Header.tsx`. This can merge with group 4.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 6. Skill and docs: `skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md`, `references/example.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `fixtures/pr32/review.json`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: 7. Synced copies (mechanical): `.agents/skills/comprehende/*` and `skills-next/comprehende/references/review.schema.json`. All are identical to their source. They can also sit with their source.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Must state

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - validate fails on a source citation whose id is not in `sources`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Old documents with `tickets` still parse and become ticket sources. A document with both `tickets` and `sources` fails.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - A comment pin counts as matching live git when the file exists on that side and the line number is inside the file. validate does not check that the line is in a hunk or that its text is the same.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - The ticket asks for an external-link arrow in the Sources row. The change makes the label the link instead, as Máté's comment on `SourceList.tsx` asks.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Good to state

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - serve and export only warn on unknown citations and stale pins, the same as for hunk coverage.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Once you jump to a pinned comment, that comment stays visible when comments are hidden. `focusCommentId` is never cleared.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Must not

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not write a bullet for the `package.json` comment. It is resolved, and `package.json` is not in the diff.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Do not add "PR says browser-tested, no automated UI tests" bullets.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## Baseline

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - 6 of 6 runs stated the three old claims, so they did not separate good reviews from weak ones.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - 0 of 6 said what a matching pin means. 4 of 6 mentioned the label and arrow comment.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Runs made 4 to 8 groups. Graders found few major issues.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: ## case.json

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `mechanicalPaths`: both synced schema copies. With one path the check always passed.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - `together`: `pins.ts` with `pins.test.ts`.

lines.author: Cursor Agent
lines.text: - Replaced the pin claim with the one on what a matching pin means. Added the arrow-to-label claim.
